nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Ultra Facial Cream with Squalane

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin report the cream is absorbed well in winter but can feel oily/greasy on the face after a few hours, with one noting daily oil-blotting was needed around the T-zone.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including very dry or dehydrated skin, consistently report strong, long-lasting hydration and relief from flaking, though a couple felt it was not thick or moisturizing enough for their needs.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report it balances dry and oily areas across the year, though some find it too heavy for oilier zones or need a richer product layered in winter.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including those with rosacea, eczema or reactive skin, most often report no irritation, burning or redness, though a minority describe itching, small pimples or a suspected bad batch.
segments.normal: Reviewers describing normal skin report a refreshing, non-sticky, non-drying feel with no issues.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 30s-50s with mature skin report visible softening of fine lines and good hydration, with one long-term user still looking for something heavier.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers report softened smile-line and forehead wrinkles and smoother-looking skin after regular use; one long-term user did not notice any effect on fine lines.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report deep, long-lasting hydration and relief from flakiness, including after retinoid/tretinoin or radiation-related dryness; a couple of reviewers with dry skin felt it did not moisturize enough for the price.
concerns.redness: Reviewers prone to redness or rosacea report calming effects with no burning or flare-ups, including one whose rosacea improved after switching from another moisturizer.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers using tretinoin/retinoids or recovering from over-drying treatments report the cream restored comfort and reduced dryness-related irritation.
concerns.spots: Reviewers with eczema report reduced itching and fewer flare-ups on the face and neck, though results are not universal since only a few eczema-specific reviews are present.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are split: several with acne-prone or hormonal acne skin say it did not cause breakouts and even helped with dryness from acne treatments, but multiple others report new whiteheads, cystic pimples, or acne flare-ups after starting use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin report the cream can leave a greasy after-feel in the T-zone or overall after several hours, though others with oily patches say oiliness decreased with continued use.

extraits.titre: BEWARE if you have acne prone skin!!!!!!!
extraits.texte: don't be fooled. I thought this would be a nice simple, fragrance-free moisturizer for my acne prone combination skin. after 2 weeks of use I experienced whiteheads, oiliness, dryness/itchiness/irritation, texture EVERYWHERE and deep, cystic pimples that hurt to the touch. it hasn't been as bad since, but it took me 6 months and lots of adapelene to clear the acne and scars. I looked it up & my suspicions were confirmed- this ranks highly for comedogenic ingredients!! be careful and pls spare yourself if you have acne prone skin. im sure its a great moisturizer for other skin types.

extraits.titre: Skin Transforming Moisturizer for my Rosacea
extraits.texte: I have extremely sensitive skin and suffer from papulopustular rosacea, which lately has been confined mostly to my nose. I have used Clinique Gel Moisturizer for over 16 years, but it started making my rosacea worse recently and burning my skin. I received a .95oz sample of this Kiehl's moisturizer from Ulta and was very happy with the ingredients list. I am even more happy with the results!! This moisturizer has transformed my skin. It's happy, clear and nothing in this irritates my skin. My skin LOVES this stuff. This is my new go-to. Even in the humid midwest summer heat, it doesn't clog pores and really does pull moisture into your skin. I'll be interested to see how it works in the winter but I am hoping for my best winter skin with this new product. 10/10 would change nothing except the price, but I'm saving money just by having healthy skin.

extraits.titre: This is my third time buying this moisturizer
extraits.texte: This is my all time favorite moisturizer. I have very sensitive dry skin and as soon as I put this on after my cleansing, my face feels so smooth and well moisturized.

This moisturizer has been a godsend! My skin feels amazing, I have been using this for only a couple of weeks and instantly have seen a difference. I am using Tretnoin and this has drastically helped with the dryness from that. My skin barrier has been restored, and I will continue to buy this.

My flare ups have been driving me crazy over the past few months, especially on my neck, but this moisturizer made a huge difference! My skin feels nourished, buttery, and NOT ITCHY. My breakouts have decreased and im starting to glow again!

extraits.titre: Honest review from a gal in her 30's
extraits.texte: When I turned 30 I struggled to find a skincare routine that worked with my maturing skin like the products that WERE my holy grails in my twenties. I've started to feel fairly self conscious about wrinkles in my smile lines and one across my forehead because nothing helped them while also not causing issues elsewhere. Then this stuff arrived after I purchased it half off during March beauty steals, and slapped it on my face like Ive done so many times before and went to bed - it didnt feel sticky, or heavy, but also doesnt seem like a thick enough product to really penetrate, you know? But, hey. Id give it a go. Ladies, I kid you not, I stared at my forehead for a good two minutes the next morning. Its been almost a week, and im still staring at it. The lines have dramatically softened, and im starting to think that maybe Ive found my 30's moisturizer. This stuff is some type of sorcery.

bought this because of the raving reviews and first thought was the price for the size is insane! la Roche posay moisturizer is 10x better and bigger for the price! second thought was it feels kinda greasy feeling on my face and doesn't really absorb that well. would I buy again? absolutely not. I bought on sale for 50% off and still wouldn't do that again.
